name: AGIBOT G2 Max
summary: A heavier-payload, force-controlled wheeled task robot for handling and palletising, announced in July 2026 with few published figures.

sellers.note: AGIBOT's regional distributor for Europe; headquarters Vienna, German office Düsseldorf. Non-binding enquiry list, individual quotation, availability subject to project-specific confirmation.

No European delivery documented.
